description:
A QA analyst is investigating intermittent Git checkout failures in Jenkins pipelines. Create a custom log recorder to capture targeted diagnostic logs without enabling global debug logging.

Create a new log recorder in Jenkins with the following configuration:

- Recorder Name: git-debug-recorder
- Logger 1: hudson.plugins.git at level FINE
- Logger 2: org.jenkinsci.plugins.gitclient at level FINE
- Logger 3: com.cloudbees.plugins.credentials at level WARNING

To access log recorders, navigate to: Manage Jenkins > System Log > Add new log recorder.

After adding all three loggers with their correct levels, save the configuration. You are already logged in as admin. If prompted to log in, use Username: admin, Password: Admin123!
